properties.name: Delhi Common Effluent Treatment Plants (aggregate, 13 plants)
properties.source_name: Parliamentary Standing Committee on Science & Technology, Environment, Forests and Climate Change, report on Water Pollution in Delhi NCR (9 Dec 2025), via PRS Legislative Research
properties.notes: Aggregate only: 13 CETPs in Delhi operating at 34% capacity (Standing Committee, Dec 2025), indicating a large volume of industrial wastewater bypassing treatment into sewers/drains. No per-CETP capacity or location is given in the summary; plotted at the Delhi centroid.

properties.name: Panipat textile and dyeing cluster
properties.source_name: CPCB Dec 2023 NGT status report (Panipat Drain No. 6 flow/BOD); cluster identity from CPCB/HSPCB descriptions of Panipat as a textile/dyeing centre
properties.notes: Cluster row, not a single plant: Panipat is the Yamuna catchment's main textile/dyeing centre; its Drain No. 6 carried 858.88 MLD at 72 mg/l BOD (61.84 TPD) in Sep 2023. No public geocoded list of the individual dyeing units exists, so no per-unit rows are given and no effluent figure is attributed to the cluster.

properties.name: Yamunanagar paper and pulp cluster
properties.source_name: CPCB Dec 2023 NGT status report (Yamuna Nagar drain flow/BOD); cluster identity from CPCB/HSPCB descriptions of Yamunanagar as a paper/plywood centre
properties.notes: Cluster row, not a single plant: Yamunanagar is the catchment's main paper/plywood centre; its drain carried 108 MLD at 222 mg/l BOD (23.98 TPD) in Sep 2023. No public geocoded list of the individual paper units exists, so no per-unit rows are given.

properties.name: Mathura Refinery (Indian Oil)
properties.source_name: Indian Oil Mathura Refinery (publicly known plant on the Yamuna at Mathura)
properties.notes: Named plant, plotted at the Mathura town centroid because no plant-site coordinates are published in the sources used. No effluent volume or BOD load is attributed: the refinery operates its own effluent treatment plant and no per-plant discharge figure for the Yamuna was found in the CPCB/NGT sources used.
